en: Colorized historical view taken from the deck of a ship looking toward a coastal city with low hills behind it. Several men in early 20th‑century naval or official uniforms stand and converse on the deck. The sea is dotted with small boats and the distant shoreline shows dense, light‑colored buildings along the waterfront. A lifebuoy, rigging, and ship structures frame the scene. At the bottom right there is a printed website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.
